title: Music: Vocal Ensembles & Choirs
script_graphic_directions: Graphic: group sizes and entries per division.
Graphic: green checks and red X's.

shots.framing: B-roll: B-roll of a choir landing its last chord.
shots.camera: Slow pull-out from the front row to the full choir; hold on the last chord
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: choir lands its last chord

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: MUSIC
graphics.subtitle: VOCAL ENSEMBLES & CHOIRS
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.storyboard_caption: Category card

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You get three to five minutes on that stage. Let's make every second count.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.storyboard_caption: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for singers.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: First, how big is your group? Two to six singers is a small ensemble. Seven to twelve is a large ensemble. Thirteen or more is a choir.

graphics.title: GROUP SIZES
graphics.subtitle: 2–6 SMALL · 7–12 LARGE · 13+ CHOIR
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.storyboard_caption: Full-screen graphic

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Large ensembles and choirs compete together, in the same category.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Full-screen graphic

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Each school can bring three small ensembles and two large groups per division. That's Elementary, Junior High and Senior High.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Full-screen graphic

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Your accompanist doesn't count. Not toward group size, and not toward grade level.

shots.storyboard_caption: P2 close-up

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Pick one song or one medley, three to five minutes long. Go over or under, and you lose a point per judge.

graphics.title: WHAT TO SING
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.storyboard_caption: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Unless you're Elementary. You won't lose points for running short.

graphics.title: WHAT TO SING
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Every song is accompanied live, on piano. No tracks.

graphics.title: WHAT TO SING
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And skip the Gospel rock, Gospel country, jazz and ragtime.

graphics.title: WHAT TO SING
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Doing a medley? Write every transition and bridge into the music.

graphics.title: WHAT TO SING
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Oh, and pick something new. You can't repeat last year's song.

graphics.title: WHAT TO SING
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: When they call your group, hand the judges three copies of your music and three judging sheets.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Use published music. Clear copies, nothing handwritten.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Checklist builds line by line

shots.framing: B-roll: numbering measures in pencil
shots.camera: Overhead, slight drift left to right as a pencil numbers measures

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Number every measure. Then mark any changes, like a key change or a cut.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: B-roll: numbering measures in pencil

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Miss either one, and it's a point per judge.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: numbering measures in pencil

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Show up at the start of your performance hour. Be ready when they call you, even if things run early.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: numbering measures in pencil

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Step up and introduce your group, your school, your song and the composer. Then the clock starts.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: numbering measures in pencil

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Everything is memorized. If it isn't, it won't be scored.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: P1 close-up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: A director can lead you. But no choreography and no big movement. Let the music do the work.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 8: P1 close-up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: When you're done, grab your copies back from the judges. Anything left behind gets tossed.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 8: P1 close-up

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: So, memorize it.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Number it.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And time it.

shots.storyboard_caption: Two-shot, quick back-and-forth

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames

shots.storyboard_caption: Shared end card
